record.original_question: Investigate whether the dense-orbit and invariant-measure phenomena discussed above persist for biholomorphisms of Cn and for volume-preserving or symplectic automorphisms of Cn.

evidence.quote: Problem 9.4. Explore the above properties for the following classes of maps in Cn : biholomorphisms of Cn and volume preserving (resp. symplectic) automorphisms of Cn (resp. Cn with n even).

artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface published resolutions of this question for biholomorphisms or volume-preserving/symplectic automorphisms of $\mathbb{C}^n$. While related results on hypercyclicity and invariant measures exist in holomorphic dynamics, no source clearly establishes or refutes the genericity of dense orbits and non-trivial invariant measures within these specific automorphism groups, so the status is treated as unverified.

status_evidence.title: arXiv:1807.05640v1 [math.CV]
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 9.4 lists exploring dense-orbit/invariant-measure properties for biholomorphisms and volume-preserving (resp. symplectic) automorphisms of C^n as an open direction.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as a research problem with no resolution provided.
